# Player

The player API for audiobook apps written for an Audiobookshelf server (`docs/server/player-apps.md`).

Back to the [web API reference](README.md).

## `GET /player/status`

Tells an app what the server is before it offers a sign-in.

Answers without a card: the version of the API it speaks and the sign-in
methods an app may offer (a player password, and the browser sign-in).

**Access:** No auth layer. Routes that need a caller say so in `security`; the handler checks it.

**Credentials:** none

### Responses

- `200` — What an app checks before it offers a sign-in. Body: [`Status`](schemas.md#status) (`application/json`)
  - `app` *string*, **required** — Always [`STATUS_APP`].
  - `serverVersion` *string*, **required** — The server release whose API this one answers like ([`crate::COMPATIBLE_SERVER_VERSION`]).
  - `isInit` *boolean*, **required** — Always true: the library is set up before an app can sign in.
  - `language` *string*, **required** — The interface language apps show server text in.
  - `authMethods` *array of string*, **required** — [`AUTH_METHODS`].
  - `authFormData` *[`AuthFormData`](schemas.md#authformdata)*, **required** — What the sign-in screen shows.

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/status'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/status'
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/status")
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/status");
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let response = reqwest::get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/status").await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

### Example response

Status `200`: What an app checks before it offers a sign-in.

```json
{
  "app": "audiobookshelf",
  "serverVersion": "2.17.0",
  "isInit": true,
  "language": "en-us",
  "authMethods": [
    "local",
    "openid"
  ],
  "authFormData": {
    "authLoginCustomMessage": "Sign in with a player password from Settings, Account, Player apps.",
    "authOpenIDButtonText": "Sign in with the library",
    "authOpenIDAutoLaunch": false
  }
}
```

Schema:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "description": "`GET /status`: what an app asks before it signs in.",
  "required": [
    "app",
    "serverVersion",
    "isInit",
    "language",
    "authMethods",
    "authFormData"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "app": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Always [`STATUS_APP`].",
      "example": "audiobookshelf"
    },
    "serverVersion": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "The server release whose API this one answers like\n([`crate::COMPATIBLE_SERVER_VERSION`]).",
      "example": "2.17.0"
    },
    "isInit": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Always true: the library is set up before an app can sign in.",
      "example": true
    },
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "The interface language apps show server text in.",
      "example": "en-us"
    },
    "authMethods": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "[`AUTH_METHODS`].",
      "example": [
        "local",
        "openid"
      ]
    },
    "authFormData": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "What the sign-in screen shows.",
      "required": [
        "authOpenIDButtonText",
        "authOpenIDAutoLaunch"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "authLoginCustomMessage": {
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "description": "A note under the sign-in form: where to get a player password.",
          "example": "Sign in with a player password from Settings, Account, Player apps."
        },
        "authOpenIDButtonText": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "The label of the browser sign-in button.",
          "example": "Sign in with the library"
        },
        "authOpenIDAutoLaunch": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "description": "Whether apps open the browser sign-in without a tap: never.",
          "example": false
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## `GET /player/ping`

Answers that the player API is up, without a card.

**Access:** No auth layer. Routes that need a caller say so in `security`; the handler checks it.

**Credentials:** none

### Responses

- `200` — The API answers. Body: [`Ping`](schemas.md#ping) (`application/json`)
  - `success` *boolean*, **required** — Always true.

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/ping'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/ping'
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/ping")
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/ping");
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let response = reqwest::get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/ping").await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

### Example response

Status `200`: The API answers.

```json
{
  "success": true
}
```

Schema:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "description": "`GET /ping`: `{ \"success\": true }`.",
  "required": [
    "success"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "success": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Always true.",
      "example": true
    }
  }
}
```

## `GET /player/healthcheck`

Answers `OK` in plain text, without a card, for apps that check health.

**Access:** No auth layer. Routes that need a caller say so in `security`; the handler checks it.

**Credentials:** none

### Responses

- `200` — `OK`. Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/healthcheck'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/healthcheck'
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/healthcheck")
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/healthcheck");
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let response = reqwest::get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/healthcheck").await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

### Example response

Status `200`: `OK`.

```text
string
```

Schema:

A `text/plain` body: a string.

## `POST /player/login`

Signs an app in with a username and a player password.

The username is the patron's sign-in name or email; the password is a
player password from Account settings, never the account password.

**Access:** No auth layer. Routes that need a caller say so in `security`; the handler checks it.

**Credentials:** none

### Request body

The sign-in name (or email) and a player password.

`application/json`: [`LoginBody`](schemas.md#loginbody)

- `username` *string*, **required** — The patron's sign-in name or email address.
- `password` *string*, **required** — A player password from Account settings; the account password is never accepted.

### Responses

- `200` — The patron, the card's tokens and settings. Body: [`PlayerLoginResponse`](schemas.md#playerloginresponse) (`application/json`)
  - `user` *[`User`](schemas.md#user)*, **required** — The signed-in patron, with the card's tokens.
  - `userDefaultLibraryId` *string*, **required** — The library an app opens first: the whole library.
  - `serverSettings` *[`ServerSettings`](schemas.md#serversettings)*, **required** — Settings apps read at sign-in.
  - `ereaderDevices` *array of object*, **required** — E-reader devices: always empty, the API serves no ebooks.
  - `Source` *string*, **required** — How the server was installed; apps only display it.
- `400` — The body is not a JSON object with string `username` and `password`. As `text/plain`, when the body is not syntactically valid JSON. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `401` — No such player password, or it belongs to someone else. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor first. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `413` — The body is over 4 KiB. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `415` — The request did not declare a JSON body. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `422` — The JSON does not fit the body: a missing field, a wrong type or an unknown shape. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be read or written. Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/login' \
    -X POST \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{"username": "riley", "password": "ABCDE-FGHJK-LMNPQ-RSTUV"}'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/login' `
    -Method Post `
    -ContentType 'application/json' `
    -Body '{"username": "riley", "password": "ABCDE-FGHJK-LMNPQ-RSTUV"}'
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/login",
    json={"username": "riley", "password": "ABCDE-FGHJK-LMNPQ-RSTUV"},
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/login", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify({"username": "riley", "password": "ABCDE-FGHJK-LMNPQ-RSTUV"}),
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let client = reqwest::Client::new();
let response = client
    .post("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/login")
    .json(&serde_json::json!({"username": "riley", "password": "ABCDE-FGHJK-LMNPQ-RSTUV"}))
    .send()
    .await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

## `POST /player/auth/refresh`

Trades a refresh token for a new access and refresh token.

**Access:** No auth layer. Routes that need a caller say so in `security`; the handler checks it.

**Credentials:** none

### Parameters

- `x-refresh-token` (header) *string*, **required** — The card's refresh token.

### Responses

- `200` — The patron and the card's new tokens. Body: [`PlayerLoginResponse`](schemas.md#playerloginresponse) (`application/json`)
  - `user` *[`User`](schemas.md#user)*, **required** — The signed-in patron, with the card's tokens.
  - `userDefaultLibraryId` *string*, **required** — The library an app opens first: the whole library.
  - `serverSettings` *[`ServerSettings`](schemas.md#serversettings)*, **required** — Settings apps read at sign-in.
  - `ereaderDevices` *array of object*, **required** — E-reader devices: always empty, the API serves no ebooks.
  - `Source` *string*, **required** — How the server was installed; apps only display it.
- `401` — No such live refresh token. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor first. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be read or written. Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/auth/refresh' \
    -X POST
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/auth/refresh' `
    -Method Post
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.post("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/auth/refresh")
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/auth/refresh", {
  method: "POST",
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let client = reqwest::Client::new();
let response = client
    .post("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/auth/refresh")
    .send()
    .await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

## `POST /player/logout`

Ends the card a refresh token (or the bearer access token) belongs to.

**Access:** No auth layer. Routes that need a caller say so in `security`; the handler checks it.

**Credentials:** none

### Parameters

- `x-refresh-token` (header) *string or null* — The card's refresh token; without it, the bearer access token names the card.

### Responses

- `200` — `OK`, whether or not a card was live. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be written. Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/logout' \
    -X POST
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/logout' `
    -Method Post
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.post("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/logout")
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/logout", {
  method: "POST",
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
    .post("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/logout")
    .send()
    .await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

```text
string
```

## `GET /player/auth/openid`

Starts the browser sign-in: answers a 302 to the library's consent
page, which the app opens in a browser.

**Access:** No auth layer. Routes that need a caller say so in `security`; the handler checks it.

**Credentials:** none

### Parameters

- `code_challenge` (query) *string*, **required** — PKCE S256 challenge.
- `code_challenge_method` (query) *string*, **required** — `S256`.
- `redirect_uri` (query) *string*, **required** — The app's address: `audiobookshelf://oauth`, `absorb://oauth` or `lissen://oauth`.
- `client_id` (query) *string* — The app's own name; echoed.
- `response_type` (query) *string* — `code`.
- `state` (query) *string* — Handed back to the app with the code.

### Responses

- `302` — `Location` is the consent page, with the parameters the app passes on. No body.
- `400` — A parameter is missing or malformed, or the app is not one the library returns to (`Invalid redirect_uri`). Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/auth/openid?code_challenge=string&code_challenge_method=string&redirect_uri=string'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/auth/openid?code_challenge=string&code_challenge_method=string&redirect_uri=string'
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/auth/openid?code_challenge=string&code_challenge_method=string&redirect_uri=string")
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/auth/openid?code_challenge=string&code_challenge_method=string&redirect_uri=string");
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let response = reqwest::get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/auth/openid?code_challenge=string&code_challenge_method=string&redirect_uri=string").await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

### Example response

Status `302`: `Location` is the consent page, with the parameters the app passes on. No body.

Status `400`: A parameter is missing or malformed, or the app is not one the library returns to (`Invalid redirect_uri`).

```text
Bad Request
```

Schema:

A `text/plain` body: a string.

## `GET /player/auth/openid/mobile-redirect`

Sends the browser back to the app with the code (or the refusal).

**Access:** No auth layer. Routes that need a caller say so in `security`; the handler checks it.

**Credentials:** none

### Parameters

- `app` (query) *string*, **required** — The app's address, one the library returns to.
- `code` (query) *string* — The code; absent when the patron declined.
- `state` (query) *string* — The app's state.

### Responses

- `302` — `Location` is the app's address with `code` and `state` (or `error=access_denied`). No body.
- `400` — The app is not one the library returns to, or a parameter is malformed. Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/auth/openid/mobile-redirect?app=string'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/auth/openid/mobile-redirect?app=string'
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/auth/openid/mobile-redirect?app=string")
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/auth/openid/mobile-redirect?app=string");
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let response = reqwest::get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/auth/openid/mobile-redirect?app=string").await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

### Example response

Status `302`: `Location` is the app's address with `code` and `state` (or `error=access_denied`). No body.

Status `400`: The app is not one the library returns to, or a parameter is malformed.

```text
Bad Request
```

Schema:

A `text/plain` body: a string.

## `GET /player/auth/openid/callback`

Trades a browser sign-in's code and PKCE verifier for a card.

**Access:** No auth layer. Routes that need a caller say so in `security`; the handler checks it.

**Credentials:** none

### Parameters

- `code` (query) *string*, **required** — The code the app was handed.
- `code_verifier` (query) *string*, **required** — The PKCE verifier.
- `state` (query) *string* — The app's state; not read.

### Responses

- `200` — The patron, the card's tokens and settings. Body: [`PlayerLoginResponse`](schemas.md#playerloginresponse) (`application/json`)
  - `user` *[`User`](schemas.md#user)*, **required** — The signed-in patron, with the card's tokens.
  - `userDefaultLibraryId` *string*, **required** — The library an app opens first: the whole library.
  - `serverSettings` *[`ServerSettings`](schemas.md#serversettings)*, **required** — Settings apps read at sign-in.
  - `ereaderDevices` *array of object*, **required** — E-reader devices: always empty, the API serves no ebooks.
  - `Source` *string*, **required** — How the server was installed; apps only display it.
- `400` — The code or verifier is missing or malformed. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `401` — The code is unknown, spent, expired, or does not match the verifier. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor first. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be read or written. Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/auth/openid/callback?code=string&code_verifier=string'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/auth/openid/callback?code=string&code_verifier=string'
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/auth/openid/callback?code=string&code_verifier=string")
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/auth/openid/callback?code=string&code_verifier=string");
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let response = reqwest::get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/auth/openid/callback?code=string&code_verifier=string").await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

## `GET /player/socket.io/`

Opens the live socket.

**Access:** No auth layer. Routes that need a caller say so in `security`; the handler checks it.

**Credentials:** none

### Parameters

- `EIO` (query) *string*, **required** — `4`.
- `transport` (query) *string*, **required** — `websocket`; long polling is not served.

### Responses

- `101` — Switching to the Socket.IO websocket. No body.
- `400` — Not a websocket upgrade, another Engine.IO revision, or long polling. Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/socket.io/?EIO=string&transport=string'
```

## `POST /player/api/authorize`

The signed-in patron, as at sign-in, without new tokens.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Responses

- `200` — The patron and settings; `user.token` is the card's access token. Body: [`PlayerLoginResponse`](schemas.md#playerloginresponse) (`application/json`)
  - `user` *[`User`](schemas.md#user)*, **required** — The signed-in patron, with the card's tokens.
  - `userDefaultLibraryId` *string*, **required** — The library an app opens first: the whole library.
  - `serverSettings` *[`ServerSettings`](schemas.md#serversettings)*, **required** — Settings apps read at sign-in.
  - `ereaderDevices` *array of object*, **required** — E-reader devices: always empty, the API serves no ebooks.
  - `Source` *string*, **required** — How the server was installed; apps only display it.
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be read. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/authorize' \
    -X POST \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <playerToken>'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/authorize' `
    -Method Post `
    -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <playerToken>' }
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/authorize",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <playerToken>"},
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/authorize", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { Authorization: "Bearer <playerToken>" },
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let client = reqwest::Client::new();
let response = client
    .post("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/authorize")
    .header("Authorization", "Bearer <playerToken>")
    .send()
    .await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

## `GET /player/api/me`

The signed-in patron.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Responses

- `200` — The patron, their progress and bookmarks. Body: [`User`](schemas.md#user) (`application/json`)
  - `id` *string*, **required** — The patron's portal identity id, as a string.
  - `username` *string*, **required** — The name the patron signs in with.
  - `email` *string or null* — The patron's email address, if the library has one.
  - `type` *string*, **required** — Always `user`: no app is given administrator powers.
  - `token` *string*, **required** — The access token, for apps that read it from here (older apps send this one as their bearer). Empty where the answer is not a sign-in.
  - `accessToken` *string or null* — The card's access token, on sign-in and refresh answers only.
  - `refreshToken` *string or null* — The card's refresh token, on sign-in and refresh answers only.
  - `isOldToken` *boolean*, **required** — Always false: tokens are never the old non-expiring kind.
  - `mediaProgress` *array of [`MediaProgress`](schemas.md#mediaprogress)*, **required** — Progress on every item the patron has started.
  - `seriesHideFromContinueListening` *array of string*, **required** — Series hidden from continue listening: none.
  - `bookmarks` *array of [`Bookmark`](schemas.md#bookmark)*, **required** — Every bookmark the patron has made.
  - `isActive` *boolean*, **required** — Always true: a disabled patron cannot sign in.
  - `isLocked` *boolean*, **required** — Always false.
  - `lastSeen` *integer (int64) or null* — When the patron was last seen, in epoch milliseconds.
  - `createdAt` *integer (int64)*, **required** — When the patron joined, in epoch milliseconds.
  - `permissions` *[`Permissions`](schemas.md#permissions)*, **required** — What the patron may do.
  - `librariesAccessible` *array of string*, **required** — Libraries the patron may open, by id.
  - `itemTagsSelected` *array of string*, **required** — Tags that limit what the patron sees: none (scope is applied by the host, not by tags).
  - `hasOpenIDLink` *boolean*, **required** — Whether the patron signed in through the browser at least once.
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be read. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me' \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <playerToken>'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me' `
    -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <playerToken>' }
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <playerToken>"},
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript

  headers: { Authorization: "Bearer <playerToken>" },
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
    .get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me")
    .header("Authorization", "Bearer <playerToken>")
    .send()
    .await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

## `GET /player/api/libraries`

Lists the libraries the patron may open: the one library.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Responses

- `200` — The library. Body: [`Libraries`](schemas.md#libraries) (`application/json`)
  - `libraries` *array of [`Library`](schemas.md#library)*, **required** — The libraries the patron may open.
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries' \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <playerToken>'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries' `
    -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <playerToken>' }
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <playerToken>"},
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries", {
  headers: { Authorization: "Bearer <playerToken>" },
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let client = reqwest::Client::new();
let response = client
    .get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries")
    .header("Authorization", "Bearer <playerToken>")
    .send()
    .await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

## `GET /player/api/libraries/{id}`

Reads the library.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Parameters

- `id` (path) *string*, **required** — Library id.
- `include` (query) *string* — `filterdata` to add the filter values.

### Responses

- `200` — The library. Body: [`LibraryAnswer`](schemas.md#libraryanswer) (`application/json`)
- `400` — A query value is out of range. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `404` — No such library. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be read. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>' \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <playerToken>'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>' `
    -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <playerToken>' }
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <playerToken>"},
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>", {
  headers: { Authorization: "Bearer <playerToken>" },
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
    .get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>")
    .header("Authorization", "Bearer <playerToken>")
    .send()
    .await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

## `GET /player/api/libraries/{id}/items`

Lists the library's items, one page at a time.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Parameters

- `id` (path) *string*, **required** — Library id.
- `limit` (query) *integer (int64)* — Items per page, at most 1000; 0 for all (up to 1000).
- `page` (query) *integer (int64)* — Page number, from 0.
- `sort` (query) *string* — `media.metadata.title`, `media.metadata.authorName`, `addedAt`, `media.duration` or `sequence`.
- `desc` (query) *integer (int32)* — 1 to reverse the order.
- `filter` (query) *string* — `group.base64value`: authors, series, genres, tags, narrators, publishers or progress.
- `include` (query) *string* — `progress` to add the patron's progress.
- `minified` (query) *integer (int32)* — Accepted; items are always the short shape.

### Responses

- `200` — A page of items. Body: [`ItemPage`](schemas.md#itempage) (`application/json`)
  - `results` *array of [`LibraryItem`](schemas.md#libraryitem)*, **required** — The page's items.
  - `total` *integer (int64)*, **required** — Items matching the query in all. At least 0.
  - `limit` *integer (int64)*, **required** — Items per page (0: no paging). At least 0.
  - `page` *integer (int64)*, **required** — The page number, from 0. At least 0.
  - `sortBy` *string or null* — The sort key the app sent, echoed.
  - `sortDesc` *boolean*, **required** — Whether the order is reversed.
  - `filterBy` *string or null* — The filter the app sent, echoed.
  - `mediaType` *string*, **required** — Always [`MEDIA_TYPE_BOOK`].
  - `minified` *boolean*, **required** — Whether items are minified.
  - `collapseseries` *boolean*, **required** — Whether series were collapsed: never.
  - `include` *string*, **required** — The include list the app sent, echoed.
  - `offset` *integer (int64)*, **required** — The offset of the first result. At least 0.
- `400` — A query value is out of range. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `404` — No such library. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be read. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/items' \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <playerToken>'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/items' `
    -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <playerToken>' }
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/items",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <playerToken>"},
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/items", {
  headers: { Authorization: "Bearer <playerToken>" },
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let client = reqwest::Client::new();
let response = client
    .get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/items")
    .header("Authorization", "Bearer <playerToken>")
    .send()
    .await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

## `GET /player/api/libraries/{id}/series`

Lists the library's series, one page at a time.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Parameters

- `id` (path) *string*, **required** — Library id.
- `limit` (query) *integer (int64)* — Series per page; 0 for all (up to 1000).
- `page` (query) *integer (int64)* — Page number, from 0.
- `desc` (query) *integer (int32)* — 1 for Z to A.

### Responses

- `200` — A page of series, each with its items. Body: [`SeriesPage`](schemas.md#seriespage) (`application/json`)
  - `results` *array of [`Series`](schemas.md#series)*, **required** — The page's series.
  - `total` *integer (int64)*, **required** — Series in all. At least 0.
  - `limit` *integer (int64)*, **required** — Series per page. At least 0.
  - `page` *integer (int64)*, **required** — The page number, from 0. At least 0.
  - `sortBy` *string or null* — The sort key, echoed.
  - `sortDesc` *boolean*, **required** — Whether the order is reversed.
  - `filterBy` *string or null* — The filter, echoed.
  - `minified` *boolean*, **required** — Whether items are minified.
  - `include` *string*, **required** — The include list, echoed.
- `400` — A query value is out of range. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `404` — No such library. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be read. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/series' \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <playerToken>'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/series' `
    -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <playerToken>' }
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/series",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <playerToken>"},
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/series", {
  headers: { Authorization: "Bearer <playerToken>" },
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let client = reqwest::Client::new();
let response = client
    .get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/series")
    .header("Authorization", "Bearer <playerToken>")
    .send()
    .await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

## `GET /player/api/libraries/{id}/authors`

Lists the library's authors.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Parameters

- `id` (path) *string*, **required** — Library id.

### Responses

- `200` — Every author, by name (up to 5000). Body: [`Authors`](schemas.md#authors) (`application/json`)
  - `authors` *array of [`Author`](schemas.md#author)*, **required** — The authors.
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `404` — No such library. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be read. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/authors' \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <playerToken>'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/authors' `
    -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <playerToken>' }
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/authors",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <playerToken>"},
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/authors", {
  headers: { Authorization: "Bearer <playerToken>" },
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let client = reqwest::Client::new();
let response = client
    .get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/authors")
    .header("Authorization", "Bearer <playerToken>")
    .send()
    .await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

## `GET /player/api/libraries/{id}/narrators`

Lists the library's narrators.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Parameters

- `id` (path) *string*, **required** — Library id.

### Responses

- `200` — Every narrator, by name (up to 5000). Body: [`Narrators`](schemas.md#narrators) (`application/json`)
  - `narrators` *array of [`Narrator`](schemas.md#narrator)*, **required** — The narrators.
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `404` — No such library. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be read. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/narrators' \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <playerToken>'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/narrators' `
    -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <playerToken>' }
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/narrators",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <playerToken>"},
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/narrators", {
  headers: { Authorization: "Bearer <playerToken>" },
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let client = reqwest::Client::new();
let response = client
    .get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/narrators")
    .header("Authorization", "Bearer <playerToken>")
    .send()
    .await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

### Example response

Status `200`: Every narrator, by name (up to 5000).

```json
    {
      "id": "li_8f14e45fceea467f",
      "name": "Ann Author",
      "numBooks": 1
    }
  ]
}
```

```json
    "narrators"
  ],

      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "description": "A narrator with how many items they read.",
        "required": [
          "id",

          "numBooks"
        ],
        "properties": {

            "type": "string",
            "description": "The name in URL-safe base64, as apps filter by it.",
            "example": "li_8f14e45fceea467f"

            "description": "Items they read that the patron can see.",
            "example": 1,
            "minimum": 0

}
```

## `GET /player/api/libraries/{id}/collections`

Lists the library's collections: none yet.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Parameters

- `id` (path) *string*, **required** — Library id.

### Responses

- `200` — An empty page. Body: [`EmptyPage`](schemas.md#emptypage) (`application/json`)
  - `results` *array of object*, **required** — Always empty.
  - `total` *integer (int64)*, **required** — Always 0. At least 0.
  - `limit` *integer (int64)*, **required** — Items per page, echoed. At least 0.
  - `page` *integer (int64)*, **required** — The page number, echoed. At least 0.
- `400` — A query value is out of range. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

## `GET /player/api/libraries/{id}/personalized`

Reads the patron's home shelves: continue listening, recently added
and listen again.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Parameters

- `id` (path) *string*, **required** — Library id.

### Responses

- `200` — The shelves that have items. Body: array of [`Shelf`](schemas.md#shelf) (`application/json`)
  - `id` *string*, **required** — The shelf id, such as `continue-listening`.
  - `label` *string*, **required** — The shelf's English label.
  - `labelStringKey` *string*, **required** — The key apps translate the label by.
  - `type` *string*, **required** — What the shelf holds: `book`, `series` or `authors`.
  - `entities` *[`ShelfEntities`](schemas.md#shelfentities)*, **required** — The shelf's entries.
  - `total` *integer (int64)*, **required** — Entries in all. At least 0.
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `404` — No such library. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be read. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/personalized' \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <playerToken>'
```

```powershell
    -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <playerToken>' }
```

```rust
let client = reqwest::Client::new();
let response = client
    .get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/personalized")
    .header("Authorization", "Bearer <playerToken>")
    .send()
    .await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

### Example response

Status `200`: The shelves that have items.

## `GET /player/api/libraries/{id}/search`

Searches the library's items, series, authors and narrators.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Parameters

- `id` (path) *string*, **required** — Library id.
- `q` (query) *string*, **required** — The search terms.
- `limit` (query) *integer (int64)* — Matches of each kind, default 12.

### Responses

- `200` — The matches. Body: [`SearchResults`](schemas.md#searchresults) (`application/json`)
  - `book` *array of [`SearchBook`](schemas.md#searchbook)*, **required** — Matching items.
  - `podcast` *array of object*, **required** — Always empty.
  - `narrators` *array of [`Narrator`](schemas.md#narrator)*, **required** — Matching narrators.
  - `tags` *array of object*, **required** — Always empty.
  - `genres` *array of object*, **required** — Always empty.
  - `series` *array of [`SearchSeries`](schemas.md#searchseries)*, **required** — Matching series.
  - `authors` *array of [`Author`](schemas.md#author)*, **required** — Matching authors.
- `400` — A query value is out of range, or the terms do not parse. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `404` — No such library. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be read. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The search index is being built; retry. Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/search?q=string' \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <playerToken>'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/search?q=string' `
    -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <playerToken>' }
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/search?q=string",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <playerToken>"},
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/search?q=string", {
  headers: { Authorization: "Bearer <playerToken>" },
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let client = reqwest::Client::new();
let response = client
    .get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/search?q=string")
    .header("Authorization", "Bearer <playerToken>")
    .send()
    .await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

## `GET /player/api/libraries/{id}/stats`

Adds up the library's items and their runtimes.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Parameters

- `id` (path) *string*, **required** — Library id.

### Responses

- `200` — Totals over the items the patron may see (runtimes over the first 20000). Body: [`LibraryStats`](schemas.md#librarystats) (`application/json`)
  - `totalItems` *integer (int64)*, **required** — Items. At least 0.
  - `totalAuthors` *integer (int64)*, **required** — Authors. At least 0.
  - `totalGenres` *integer (int64)*, **required** — Genres. At least 0.
  - `totalDuration` *number (double)*, **required** — Seconds of audio in all.
  - `numAudioTracks` *integer (int64)*, **required** — Audio tracks in all. At least 0.
  - `totalSize` *integer (int64)*, **required** — Bytes in all: not counted. At least 0.
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `404` — No such library. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be read. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/stats' \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <playerToken>'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/stats' `
    -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <playerToken>' }
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/stats",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <playerToken>"},
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/stats", {
  headers: { Authorization: "Bearer <playerToken>" },
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let client = reqwest::Client::new();
let response = client
    .get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/libraries/<id>/stats")
    .header("Authorization", "Bearer <playerToken>")
    .send()
    .await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

## `GET /player/api/libraries/{id}/filterdata`

Reads the library's filter values.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Parameters

- `id` (path) *string*, **required** — Library id.

### Responses

- `200` — The filter values. Body: [`FilterData`](schemas.md#filterdata) (`application/json`)
  - `authors` *array of [`NamedRef`](schemas.md#namedref)*, **required** — Authors with at least one item.
  - `genres` *array of string*, **required** — Genres.
  - `tags` *array of string*, **required** — Tags: none are shown.
  - `series` *array of [`NamedRef`](schemas.md#namedref)*, **required** — Series with at least one item.
  - `narrators` *array of string*, **required** — Narrators.
  - `languages` *array of string*, **required** — Languages.
  - `publishers` *array of string*, **required** — Publishers.
  - `publishedDecades` *array of string*, **required** — Decades of publication: none are offered.
  - `bookCount` *integer (int64)*, **required** — Items in the library. At least 0.
  - `authorCount` *integer (int64)*, **required** — Authors in the library. At least 0.
  - `seriesCount` *integer (int64)*, **required** — Series in the library. At least 0.
  - `podcastCount` *integer (int64)*, **required** — Always 0. At least 0.
  - `numberEpisodes` *integer (int64)*, **required** — Always 0. At least 0.
  - `loadedAt` *integer (int64)*, **required** — When the values were read, in epoch milliseconds.
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `404` — No such library. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be read. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

## `GET /player/api/series/{id}`

Reads one series with its items and the patron's progress through it.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Parameters

- `id` (path) *string*, **required** — Series id.

### Responses

- `200` — The series. Body: [`Series`](schemas.md#series) (`application/json`)
  - `id` *string*, **required** — The series id.
  - `name` *string*, **required** — Its name.
  - `nameIgnorePrefix` *string*, **required** — The name for sorting.
  - `description` *string or null* — Its description: none.
  - `addedAt` *integer (int64)*, **required** — When the library first saw it, in epoch milliseconds.
  - `updatedAt` *integer (int64)*, **required** — When it last changed, in epoch milliseconds.
  - `libraryId` *string*, **required** — The library it is listed in.
  - `books` *array of [`LibraryItem`](schemas.md#libraryitem) or null* — Its items in series order, on lists.
  - `progress` *[`SeriesProgress`](schemas.md#seriesprogress) or null* — The patron's progress through it, when asked for.
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `404` — No such series the patron may see. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be read. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/series/<id>' \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <playerToken>'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/series/<id>' `
    -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <playerToken>' }
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/series/<id>",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <playerToken>"},
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/series/<id>", {
  headers: { Authorization: "Bearer <playerToken>" },
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let client = reqwest::Client::new();
let response = client
    .get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/series/<id>")
    .header("Authorization", "Bearer <playerToken>")
    .send()
    .await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

Schema:

## `GET /player/api/authors/{id}`

Reads one author, with their items and series when asked for.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Parameters

- `id` (path) *string*, **required** — Author id.
- `include` (query) *string* — `items` and/or `series`.

### Responses

- `200` — The author. Body: [`Author`](schemas.md#author) (`application/json`)
  - `id` *string*, **required** — The contributor id.
  - `asin` *string or null* — Always null.
  - `name` *string*, **required** — The author's name.
  - `lastFirst` *string*, **required** — The name family name first.
  - `description` *string or null* — Always null.
  - `imagePath` *string or null* — Always null: no author images.
  - `libraryId` *string*, **required** — The library it is listed in.
  - `addedAt` *integer (int64)*, **required** — When the library first saw the author, in epoch milliseconds.
  - `updatedAt` *integer (int64)*, **required** — When the record last changed, in epoch milliseconds.
  - `numBooks` *integer (int64)*, **required** — Items by the author the patron can see. At least 0.
  - `libraryItems` *array of [`LibraryItem`](schemas.md#libraryitem) or null* — The author's items, when asked for.
  - `series` *array of [`AuthorSeries`](schemas.md#authorseries) or null* — The author's series with their items, when asked for.
- `400` — A query value is out of range. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `404` — No such author the patron may see. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be read. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/authors/<id>' \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <playerToken>'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/authors/<id>' `
    -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <playerToken>' }
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/authors/<id>",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <playerToken>"},
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/authors/<id>", {
  headers: { Authorization: "Bearer <playerToken>" },
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let client = reqwest::Client::new();
let response = client
    .get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/authors/<id>")
    .header("Authorization", "Bearer <playerToken>")
    .send()
    .await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

## `GET /player/api/items/{id}`

Reads one item; expanded, with its tracks and files.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Parameters

- `id` (path) *string*, **required** — Item id.
- `expanded` (query) *integer (int32)* — 1 to add tracks and files.
- `include` (query) *string* — `progress` to add the patron's progress.

### Responses

- `200` — The item. Body: [`LibraryItem`](schemas.md#libraryitem) (`application/json`)
  - `id` *string*, **required** — The item id: the edition id.
  - `ino` *string*, **required** — The item's inode as apps expect one: the edition id again.
  - `oldLibraryItemId` *string or null* — Always null.
  - `libraryId` *string*, **required** — The library the item is listed in.
  - `folderId` *string*, **required** — The folder id: the library id.
  - `path` *string*, **required** — A display path: the title.
  - `relPath` *string*, **required** — A display path: the title.
  - `isFile` *boolean*, **required** — Always false: an item is a folder of tracks.
  - `mtimeMs` *integer (int64)*, **required** — When the copy last changed, in epoch milliseconds.
  - `ctimeMs` *integer (int64)*, **required** — When the copy was stored, in epoch milliseconds.
  - `birthtimeMs` *integer (int64)*, **required** — When the copy was stored, in epoch milliseconds.
  - `addedAt` *integer (int64)*, **required** — When the item joined the library, in epoch milliseconds.
  - `updatedAt` *integer (int64)*, **required** — When its record last changed, in epoch milliseconds.
  - `isMissing` *boolean*, **required** — Always false.
  - `isInvalid` *boolean*, **required** — Always false.
  - `mediaType` *string*, **required** — Always [`MEDIA_TYPE_BOOK`].
  - `media` *[`BookMedia`](schemas.md#bookmedia)*, **required** — The book.
  - `numFiles` *integer (int64)*, **required** — Files in the item. At least 0.
  - `size` *integer (int64)*, **required** — Bytes in all its files. At least 0.
  - `libraryFiles` *array of [`LibraryFile`](schemas.md#libraryfile) or null* — The item's files, when the item is fetched expanded.
  - `userMediaProgress` *[`MediaProgress`](schemas.md#mediaprogress) or null* — The patron's progress, when the app asked for it.
  - `seriesSequence` *string or null* — The item's place in a series, on a series' book list.
- `400` — A query value is out of range. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `404` — No such item the patron may see. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be read. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/items/<id>' \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <playerToken>'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/items/<id>' `
    -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <playerToken>' }
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/items/<id>",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <playerToken>"},
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/items/<id>", {
  headers: { Authorization: "Bearer <playerToken>" },
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let client = reqwest::Client::new();
let response = client
    .get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/items/<id>")
    .header("Authorization", "Bearer <playerToken>")
    .send()
    .await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

Schema:

## `POST /player/api/items/batch/get`

Reads several items at once.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Request body

The items to read, at most 100.

`application/json`: [`BatchGetBody`](schemas.md#batchgetbody)

- `libraryItemIds` *array of string*, **required** — The items, at most 100.

### Responses

- `200` — The items the patron may see, in the given order. Body: [`LibraryItems`](schemas.md#libraryitems) (`application/json`)
  - `libraryItems` *array of [`LibraryItem`](schemas.md#libraryitem)*, **required** — The items.
- `400` — The body is malformed. As `text/plain`, when the body is not syntactically valid JSON. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `413` — The body is too long. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `415` — The request did not declare a JSON body. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `422` — The JSON does not fit the body: a missing field, a wrong type or an unknown shape. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be read. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/items/batch/get' \
    -X POST \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <playerToken>' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{"libraryItemIds": ["li_8f14e45fceea467f"]}'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/items/batch/get' `
    -Method Post `
    -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <playerToken>' } `
    -ContentType 'application/json' `
    -Body '{"libraryItemIds": ["li_8f14e45fceea467f"]}'
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/items/batch/get",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <playerToken>"},
    json={"libraryItemIds": ["li_8f14e45fceea467f"]},
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

## `GET /player/api/items/{id}/cover`

Serves an item's cover.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Parameters

- `id` (path) *string*, **required** — Item id.

### Responses

- `200` — The cover. Body: binary (`image/jpeg`)
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `404` — No such item, or no cover of it on this node. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library or the cover could not be read. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/items/<id>/cover' \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <playerToken>'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/items/<id>/cover' `
    -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <playerToken>' }
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/items/<id>/cover",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <playerToken>"},
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/items/<id>/cover", {
  headers: { Authorization: "Bearer <playerToken>" },
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let client = reqwest::Client::new();
let response = client
    .get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/items/<id>/cover")
    .header("Authorization", "Bearer <playerToken>")
    .send()
    .await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

### Example response

Status `200`: The cover. The body is binary (`image/jpeg`).

## `POST /player/api/items/{id}/play`

Opens a play session on an item.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Parameters

- `id` (path) *string*, **required** — Item id.

### Request body

The device and what the app asks for; tracks always play directly.

`application/json`: [`PlayBody`](schemas.md#playbody)

- `deviceInfo` *[`DeviceInfoBody`](schemas.md#deviceinfobody) or null* — The device, named in the patron's session list.
- `forceDirectPlay` *boolean or null* — Whether the app asks for direct play; tracks always play directly.
- `forceTranscode` *boolean or null* — Whether the app asks for transcoding; it gets direct tracks too.
- `mediaPlayer` *string or null* — The app's player, shown in the session list.

### Responses

- `200` — The session, its tracks and where to start. Body: [`PlaybackSession`](schemas.md#playbacksession) (`application/json`)
  - `id` *string*, **required** — The session id; apps send it back to sync and close.
  - `userId` *string*, **required** — The patron's id.
  - `libraryId` *string*, **required** — The library id.
  - `libraryItemId` *string*, **required** — The item id.
  - `bookId` *string*, **required** — The media id: the item id.
  - `episodeId` *string or null* — Always null.
  - `mediaType` *string*, **required** — Always [`MEDIA_TYPE_BOOK`].
  - `mediaMetadata` *[`BookMetadata`](schemas.md#bookmetadata)*, **required** — The book's metadata.
  - `chapters` *array of [`Chapter`](schemas.md#chapter)*, **required** — The book's chapters.
  - `displayTitle` *string*, **required** — The title apps show.
  - `displayAuthor` *string*, **required** — The author apps show.
  - `coverPath` *string or null* — A cover path apps test for presence.
  - `duration` *number (double)*, **required** — The book's length in seconds.
  - `playMethod` *integer (int32)*, **required** — How the app plays: 0, direct play of the stored files. At least 0.
  - `mediaPlayer` *string*, **required** — The player the app reported.
  - `deviceInfo` *[`SessionDevice`](schemas.md#sessiondevice)*, **required** — The device the session was opened from.
  - `serverVersion` *string*, **required** — [`crate::COMPATIBLE_SERVER_VERSION`].
  - `date` *string*, **required** — The day the session started, `YYYY-MM-DD` in UTC.
  - `dayOfWeek` *string*, **required** — The weekday the session started, in English.
  - `timeListening` *number (double)*, **required** — Seconds listened in this session.
  - `startTime` *number (double)*, **required** — Where the session started, in seconds.
  - `currentTime` *number (double)*, **required** — Where the patron is, in seconds.
  - `startedAt` *integer (int64)*, **required** — When the session started, in epoch milliseconds.
  - `updatedAt` *integer (int64)*, **required** — When it last synced, in epoch milliseconds.
  - `audioTracks` *array of [`AudioTrack`](schemas.md#audiotrack)*, **required** — The tracks to play, in order.
  - `libraryItem` *[`LibraryItem`](schemas.md#libraryitem) or null* — The item, expanded.
- `400` — The body is malformed. As `text/plain`, when the body is not syntactically valid JSON. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `404` — No such item, or nothing of it this patron may play here. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `413` — The body is too long. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `415` — The request did not declare a JSON body. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `422` — The JSON does not fit the body: a missing field, a wrong type or an unknown shape. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be read or written. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — Storage could not be asked; retry. Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/items/<id>/play' \
    -X POST \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <playerToken>' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{}'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/items/<id>/play' `
    -Method Post `
    -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <playerToken>' } `
    -ContentType 'application/json' `
    -Body '{}'
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/items/<id>/play",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <playerToken>"},
    json={},
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
  method: "POST",
  headers: { Authorization: "Bearer <playerToken>", "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify({}),
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
    .json(&serde_json::json!({}))
    .send()
    .await?;

```

## `GET /player/api/items/{id}/file/{ino}`

Streams one audio file of an item.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Parameters

- `id` (path) *string*, **required** — Item id.
- `ino` (path) *string*, **required** — The file's `ino` from the item's tracks.
- `Range` (header) *string or null* — One byte range.

### Responses

- `200` — The whole file. Body: binary (`audio/mp4`)
- `206` — The requested byte range. Body: binary (`audio/mp4`)
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `404` — No such item or file, or nothing of it this patron may play here. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `416` — The range starts past the end of the file; `Content-Range` states the size. Body: [`ErrorMessage`](schemas.md#errormessage) (`application/json`)
  - `error` *string*, **required** — What went wrong, as the handler describes it.
- `500` — The library could not be read. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — Storage could not be asked; retry. Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/items/<id>/file/<ino>' \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <playerToken>'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/items/<id>/file/<ino>' `
    -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <playerToken>' }
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/items/<id>/file/<ino>",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <playerToken>"},
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/items/<id>/file/<ino>", {
  headers: { Authorization: "Bearer <playerToken>" },
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let client = reqwest::Client::new();
let response = client
    .get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/items/<id>/file/<ino>")
    .header("Authorization", "Bearer <playerToken>")
    .send()
    .await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

## `GET /player/api/items/{id}/file/{ino}/download`

Downloads one audio file of an item for offline listening.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Parameters

- `id` (path) *string*, **required** — Item id.
- `ino` (path) *string*, **required** — The file's `ino` from the item's audio files.
- `Range` (header) *string or null* — One byte range, to resume.

### Responses

- `200` — The whole file, as an attachment. Body: binary (`audio/mp4`)
- `206` — The requested byte range. Body: binary (`audio/mp4`)
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron may not save files offline. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `404` — No such item or file, or nothing of it this patron may play here. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `416` — The range starts past the end of the file; `Content-Range` states the size. Body: [`ErrorMessage`](schemas.md#errormessage) (`application/json`)
  - `error` *string*, **required** — What went wrong, as the handler describes it.
- `500` — The library could not be read. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — Storage could not be asked; retry. Body: string (`text/plain`)

## `POST /player/api/session/{id}/sync`

Reports where the patron is in a playing session.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Parameters

- `id` (path) *string*, **required** — Session id from the play answer.

### Request body

Where the patron is, in seconds.

`application/json`: [`SyncBody`](schemas.md#syncbody)

- `currentTime` *number (double) or null* — The position, in seconds.
- `timeListened` *number (double) or null* — Seconds listened since the last sync.
- `duration` *number (double) or null* — The runtime the app measured, in seconds.

### Responses

- `200` — `OK`. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `400` — The body is malformed. As `text/plain`, when the body is not syntactically valid JSON. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `404` — No such session of the patron's. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `409` — The session ended; open a new one. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `413` — The body is too long. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `415` — The request did not declare a JSON body. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `422` — The JSON does not fit the body: a missing field, a wrong type or an unknown shape. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be written. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

```console
    -d '{}'
```

## `POST /player/api/session/local`

Uploads one session an app played offline.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

An offline session.

`application/json`: [`LocalSessionBody`](schemas.md#localsessionbody)

- `id` *string*, **required** — The app's own id for the session.

- `currentTime` *number (double)*, **required** — The position, in seconds.
- `timeListening` *number (double) or null* — Seconds listened in the session.
- `duration` *number (double) or null* — The runtime the app measured, in seconds.
- `updatedAt` *integer (int64) or null* — When the app last updated the session, in epoch milliseconds.

- `400` — The body is malformed. As `text/plain`, when the body is not syntactically valid JSON. Body: string (`text/plain`)

- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `404` — No such item. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `413` — The body is too long. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `415` — The request did not declare a JSON body. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `422` — The JSON does not fit the body: a missing field, a wrong type or an unknown shape. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be written. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

## `POST /player/api/session/local-all`

Uploads every session an app played offline.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

Offline sessions, each as `POST /player/api/session/local` takes one.

## `GET /player/api/me/progress/{id}`

Reads the patron's progress on an item.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Parameters

- `id` (path) *string*, **required** — Item id.

### Responses

- `200` — The progress. Body: [`MediaProgress`](schemas.md#mediaprogress) (`application/json`)
  - `id` *string*, **required** — The progress id: the item id (one record per patron and item).
  - `userId` *string*, **required** — The patron's id.
  - `libraryItemId` *string*, **required** — The item id.
  - `episodeId` *string or null* — Always null.
  - `mediaItemId` *string*, **required** — The media id: the item id.
  - `mediaItemType` *string*, **required** — Always `book`.
  - `duration` *number (double)*, **required** — The book's length in seconds, as last reported.
  - `progress` *number (double)*, **required** — The share listened, from 0 to 1.
  - `currentTime` *number (double)*, **required** — Where the patron is, in seconds.
  - `isFinished` *boolean*, **required** — Whether the patron finished it.
  - `hideFromContinueListening` *boolean*, **required** — Whether it is hidden from continue listening.
  - `ebookLocation` *string or null* — Always null.
  - `ebookProgress` *number (double) or null* — Always null.
  - `lastUpdate` *integer (int64)*, **required** — When the progress last changed, in epoch milliseconds.
  - `startedAt` *integer (int64)*, **required** — When the patron started, in epoch milliseconds.
  - `finishedAt` *integer (int64) or null* — When the patron finished, in epoch milliseconds.
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `404` — No progress on that item. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be read. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
