## `PATCH /player/api/me/progress/{id}`

Sets the patron's progress on an item: a seek, Mark finished or Start
over.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Parameters

- `id` (path) *string*, **required** — Item id.

### Request body

The fields to change.

`application/json`: [`ProgressBody`](schemas.md#progressbody)

- `currentTime` *number (double) or null* — The position, in seconds.
- `progress` *number (double) or null* — The share of `duration` listened, 0 to 1, read when `currentTime` is absent.
- `duration` *number (double) or null* — The runtime, in seconds.
- `isFinished` *boolean or null* — Whether the book is finished.
- `hideFromContinueListening` *boolean or null* — True to take the item off Continue listening.

### Responses

- `200` — `OK`. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `400` — The body is malformed. As `text/plain`, when the body is not syntactically valid JSON. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `404` — No such item. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `413` — The body is too long. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `415` — The request did not declare a JSON body. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `422` — The JSON does not fit the body: a missing field, a wrong type or an unknown shape. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be written. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/progress/<id>' \
    -X PATCH \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <playerToken>' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{}'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/progress/<id>' `
    -Method Patch `
    -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <playerToken>' } `
    -ContentType 'application/json' `
    -Body '{}'
```

```python
    json={},
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

## `GET /player/api/me/listening-sessions`

Lists the patron's play sessions, newest first.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Parameters

- `itemsPerPage` (query) *integer (int64)* — Sessions per page, default 10.
- `page` (query) *integer (int64)* — Page number, from 0.

### Responses

- `200` — A page of sessions. Body: [`SessionPage`](schemas.md#sessionpage) (`application/json`)
  - `total` *integer (int64)*, **required** — Sessions in all. At least 0.
  - `numPages` *integer (int64)*, **required** — Pages in all. At least 0.
  - `page` *integer (int64)*, **required** — The page number, from 0. At least 0.
  - `itemsPerPage` *integer (int64)*, **required** — Sessions per page. At least 0.
  - `sessions` *array of [`PlaybackSession`](schemas.md#playbacksession)*, **required** — The page's sessions, newest first.
- `400` — A query value is out of range. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be read. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/listening-sessions' \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <playerToken>'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/listening-sessions' `
    -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <playerToken>' }
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/listening-sessions",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <playerToken>"},
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/listening-sessions", {
  headers: { Authorization: "Bearer <playerToken>" },
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let client = reqwest::Client::new();
let response = client
    .get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/listening-sessions")
    .header("Authorization", "Bearer <playerToken>")
    .send()
    .await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

Schema:

## `GET /player/api/me/listening-stats`

Sums the patron's listening, by item and by day.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Responses

- `200` — Listening totals over the patron's latest 1000 sessions. Body: [`ListeningStats`](schemas.md#listeningstats) (`application/json`)
  - `totalTime` *number (double)*, **required** — Seconds listened in all.
  - `items` *map of string to [`ItemListening`](schemas.md#itemlistening)*, **required** — Seconds listened per item, by item id.
  - `days` *map of string to number (double)*, **required** — Seconds listened per day, by `YYYY-MM-DD`.
  - `dayOfWeek` *map of string to number (double)*, **required** — Seconds listened per weekday, by English weekday name.
  - `today` *number (double)*, **required** — Seconds listened today.
  - `recentSessions` *array of [`PlaybackSession`](schemas.md#playbacksession)*, **required** — The most recent sessions.
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be read. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/listening-stats' \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <playerToken>'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/listening-stats' `
    -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <playerToken>' }
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/listening-stats",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <playerToken>"},
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/listening-stats", {
  headers: { Authorization: "Bearer <playerToken>" },
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let client = reqwest::Client::new();
let response = client
    .get("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/listening-stats")
    .header("Authorization", "Bearer <playerToken>")
    .send()
    .await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

## `POST /player/api/me/item/{id}/bookmark`

Adds a bookmark to an item.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Parameters

- `id` (path) *string*, **required** — Item id.

### Request body

The place, in seconds, and a title.

`application/json`: [`BookmarkBody`](schemas.md#bookmarkbody)

- `time` *number (double)*, **required** — The place, in seconds; on `PATCH`, which bookmark to rename.
- `title` *string or null* — The bookmark's title.

### Responses

- `200` — The bookmark. Body: [`Bookmark`](schemas.md#bookmark) (`application/json`)
  - `libraryItemId` *string*, **required** — The item it is in.
  - `title` *string*, **required** — Its title.
  - `time` *number (double)*, **required** — Where it is, in seconds.
  - `createdAt` *integer (int64)*, **required** — When it was made, in epoch milliseconds.
- `400` — The body is malformed. As `text/plain`, when the body is not syntactically valid JSON. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `404` — No such item. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `409` — The patron has as many bookmarks as the library keeps. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `413` — The body is too long. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `415` — The request did not declare a JSON body. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `422` — The JSON does not fit the body: a missing field, a wrong type or an unknown shape. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be written. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/item/<id>/bookmark' \
    -X POST \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <playerToken>' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{"time": 1830.0}'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/item/<id>/bookmark' `
    -Method Post `
    -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <playerToken>' } `
    -ContentType 'application/json' `
    -Body '{"time": 1830.0}'
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/item/<id>/bookmark",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <playerToken>"},
    json={"time": 1830.0},
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/item/<id>/bookmark", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { Authorization: "Bearer <playerToken>", "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify({"time": 1830.0}),
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let client = reqwest::Client::new();
let response = client
    .post("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/item/<id>/bookmark")
    .header("Authorization", "Bearer <playerToken>")
    .json(&serde_json::json!({"time": 1830.0}))
    .send()
    .await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

## `PATCH /player/api/me/item/{id}/bookmark`

Renames the bookmark at a time in an item.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Parameters

- `id` (path) *string*, **required** — Item id.

### Request body

Which bookmark, by its place in seconds, and its new title.

`application/json`: [`BookmarkBody`](schemas.md#bookmarkbody)

- `time` *number (double)*, **required** — The place, in seconds; on `PATCH`, which bookmark to rename.
- `title` *string or null* — The bookmark's title.

### Responses

- `200` — The bookmark. Body: [`Bookmark`](schemas.md#bookmark) (`application/json`)
  - `libraryItemId` *string*, **required** — The item it is in.
  - `title` *string*, **required** — Its title.
  - `time` *number (double)*, **required** — Where it is, in seconds.
  - `createdAt` *integer (int64)*, **required** — When it was made, in epoch milliseconds.
- `400` — The body is malformed. As `text/plain`, when the body is not syntactically valid JSON. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `404` — No such item or bookmark. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `413` — The body is too long. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `415` — The request did not declare a JSON body. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `422` — The JSON does not fit the body: a missing field, a wrong type or an unknown shape. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be written. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/item/<id>/bookmark' \
    -X PATCH \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <playerToken>' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{"time": 1830.0}'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/item/<id>/bookmark' `
    -Method Patch `
    -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <playerToken>' } `
    -ContentType 'application/json' `
    -Body '{"time": 1830.0}'
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.patch(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/item/<id>/bookmark",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <playerToken>"},
    json={"time": 1830.0},
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/item/<id>/bookmark", {
  method: "PATCH",
  headers: { Authorization: "Bearer <playerToken>", "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify({"time": 1830.0}),
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
let client = reqwest::Client::new();
let response = client
    .patch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/item/<id>/bookmark")
    .header("Authorization", "Bearer <playerToken>")
    .json(&serde_json::json!({"time": 1830.0}))
    .send()
    .await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```

```json
  "createdAt": 1763600000000
}
```

## `DELETE /player/api/me/item/{id}/bookmark/{time}`

Removes the bookmark at a time in an item.

**Access:** A player card's access token only (`/player/login`, `/player/auth/refresh` or the browser sign-in), from a signed-in, active patron; what the patron's scope hides answers 404.

**Credentials:** `playerToken`

### Parameters

- `id` (path) *string*, **required** — Item id.
- `time` (path) *string*, **required** — The bookmark's time in seconds.

### Responses

- `200` — `OK`. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `401` — No live player card (`Unauthorized`, plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `403` — The patron must enroll a second factor on the library's website first (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `404` — No such item or bookmark. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `500` — The library could not be written. Body: string (`text/plain`)
- `503` — The card could not be checked; retry (plain text). Body: string (`text/plain`)

### Example request

```console
$ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/item/<id>/bookmark/<time>' \
    -X DELETE \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <playerToken>'
```

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/item/<id>/bookmark/<time>' `
    -Method Delete `
    -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer <playerToken>' }
```

```python
import requests

response = requests.delete(
    "http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/item/<id>/bookmark/<time>",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer <playerToken>"},
)
print(response.status_code, response.text)
```

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8787/player/api/me/item/<id>/bookmark/<time>", {
  method: "DELETE",
  headers: { Authorization: "Bearer <playerToken>" },
});
console.log(response.status, await response.text());
```

```rust
    .header("Authorization", "Bearer <playerToken>")
    .send()
    .await?;
println!("{} {}", response.status(), response.text().await?);
```
